name: Zephrys, the Great
guide_text: Use your first hero power or two on early pairs to try to stabilize. You can use your last hero power on a core card for your direction, such as [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or [[Titus Rivendare||97408]].
buddy_guide_text: If a certain triple is extremely important, sell everything except 3 cards and pairs to guarantee you get the triple.
